label: 标准层复制
description: 把已建好的一层（parts 列出的全部构件 part）整体沿 Z 复制成 count 层。默认 mode="merge"：先把每件构件的位姿展平（静态路直接用各 part 自己的 origin/rpy，有 joint 时沿层内 joint 做正向运动学），再把整层烘成**单个多材质 GLB**（逐件颜色内嵌进网格），然后摘掉原来那一层的 part / 层内 joint，换成每层一个 part(shape=mesh(<sha>.glb)) —— 20 层塔楼只剩 20 个 part 而不是 600 个，且全楼只有一份网格数据。层与层之间自动补一条 fixed joint（origin=[0,0,层高]）；整段 DSL 没有 joint 时（静态路）改为抬高每层 part 的 origin。mode="instance" 则不烘焙，逐层复制 part/joint 行、副本共享同一批 shape/material 语句，part 数是 merge 的 N 倍，只在需要单独寻址某层某件（可动的门、逐件碰撞体）时用。静态路（无 joint）上 merge 出来的 mesh 引用件可以和手写的真形状件（屋顶、雨棚…）自由混用，两者分区导出、都不会被丢掉。输出 id 指向最高层，可直接作为屋顶的 joint parent（静态路则给屋顶写绝对 origin 或用 place_local 摆到最高层上）。当 prompt 提到 高楼 / 塔楼 / 标准层 / 多层重复 / 层复制 / high-rise 时使用。
description-en: Repeat one already-modelled storey (the parts listed in `parts`) up the Z axis into `count` storeys. Default mode="merge": flatten every element's pose (each part's own origin/rpy on the static path, or forward kinematics over the intra-storey joints when the model has any), bake the whole storey into a SINGLE multi-material GLB (per-element colours embedded in the mesh), then drop the original storey's parts / intra-storey joints and replace them with one `part(shape=mesh(<sha>.glb))` per storey — a 20-storey tower costs 20 parts instead of 600, with a single copy of the mesh data. Consecutive storeys are linked by an auto-generated fixed joint (origin=[0,0,storey_height]); when the DSL has no joints at all (static pipeline) each storey part is lifted by its own `origin` instead. mode="instance" skips baking and copies the `part`/`joint` lines per storey (copies share the same shape/material statements), costing N× the parts — use it only when a single element of a given storey must stay addressable (an openable door, per-element collision). On the jointless static path the merged mesh-reference storeys mix freely with hand-authored real-shape parts (roof, canopy, …): the two are exported through separate partitions and neither is dropped. The output id points at the top storey, ready to be the roof's joint parent (on the static path give the roof an absolute origin, or place_local it onto the top storey). Use for high-rise, tower, typical-floor and other repeated-storey buildings.

inputs.name: part_ids
inputs.label: 本层构件
inputs.description: 本层全部构件的 part id；JSON 数组或逗号分隔，如 ["p_slab","p_w1"]
inputs.description-en: Part ids making up the storey; JSON array or comma-separated.

inputs.name: root_id
inputs.label: 本层根件
inputs.description: 层间 fixed joint 挂接的根 part id；空=自动取本层子树的根。merge 模式下合并 GLB 的坐标系就是它的坐标系
inputs.description-en: Root part id the inter-storey fixed joint attaches to; empty = infer the storey subtree root. In merge mode the baked GLB's frame is this part's frame.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: 模式
inputs.description: merge=整层烘成单个多材质 GLB，每层只剩 1 个 part（默认，最轻）；instance=逐层复制每个 part/joint，保留逐件可寻址
inputs.description-en: merge = bake the storey into one multi-material GLB, 1 part per storey (default, lightest); instance = copy every part/joint per storey, keeping elements individually addressable.

inputs.name: count
inputs.label: 总层数
inputs.description: 总层数（含被复制的原始层）；count=5 → 共 5 层
inputs.description-en: Total storeys including the modelled one; 5 means 5 storeys.

inputs.name: storey_height
inputs.label: 层高
inputs.description: 每层相对下层抬升的 Z（米）

inputs.name: levels
inputs.label: 自定义标高
inputs.description: 可选：各上层相对最底层的 Z 偏移 JSON（递增，米），如 [3.2,6.4,10.6]；给了就忽略 count/层高
inputs.description-en: Optional JSON of strictly increasing Z offsets above the bottom storey; overrides count/storey_height.

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.label: 生成前缀
inputs.description: 生成 id 的前缀（merge → <prefix>_l1..lN；instance → <prefix>_l2_<原id>）；空=lv
inputs.description-en: Prefix for generated ids (merge → <prefix>_l1..lN; instance → <prefix>_l2_<origId>); empty = lv.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.description: 自定义 id；同时作为生成前缀的缺省来源
inputs.description-en: Custom id; also the default source of the generated-id prefix.

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 复制完各层后的 Geometry（merge 模式下原始层的 part/层内 joint 已被合并 part 顶替）
outputs.description-en: Geometry after the storeys are repeated (in merge mode the original storey's parts / intra-storey joints are replaced by the merged parts).

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.description: 最高层的 part id（屋顶的 joint parent）
outputs.description-en: Part id of the top storey (the roof's joint parent).

outputs.name: level_roots
outputs.label: 各层根件
outputs.description: 各层根 part 的 id（JSON 数组，自下而上）
outputs.description-en: JSON array of each storey's root part id, bottom-up.

outputs.name: filename
outputs.label: Mesh 文件名
outputs.description: merge 模式下整层的多材质 GLB 文件名 <sha>.glb；instance 模式为空
outputs.description-en: Content-addressed <sha>.glb of the merged storey in merge mode; empty in instance mode.

outputs.name: sha256
outputs.label: sha256
outputs.description: 合并 GLB 的 sha256 内容指纹；instance 模式为空
outputs.description-en: sha256 fingerprint of the merged GLB; empty in instance mode.

outputs.name: vertex_count
outputs.label: 顶点数
outputs.description: 合并 GLB 的顶点数（一层的量，全楼共享）
outputs.description-en: Vertex count of the merged storey GLB (one storey's worth, shared by all).

outputs.name: triangle_count
outputs.label: 三角面数
outputs.description: 合并 GLB 的三角面数（一层的量，全楼共享）
outputs.description-en: Triangle count of the merged storey GLB (one storey's worth, shared by all).

outputs.name: note
outputs.label: 提示
outputs.description: 非错误说明（合并结果、part 数对比）
